## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and traceable to its purpose (no unrelated refactors).
- [ ] `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest` passes; tests added/updated where practical.
- [ ] `./gradlew :app:lintDebug` shows no new blocking issues.
- [ ] **No secrets** committed (API keys, `keystore.properties`, `*.jks`, OAuth secrets, tokens).
- [ ] **No model binaries** committed (`.task`, `.litertlm`, `.gguf`, `.safetensors`).
- [ ] If dependencies changed, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` was updated in the same PR.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this code and agree it is licensed under **Apache-2.0**
      (inbound = outbound); it contains no employer-owned or confidential material.
